summary: Larkin Partners is a boutique Ivanhoe (Melbourne) accounting and advisory firm led by Roger Larkin, who has been director since 2000. It serves SMEs, high net worth families and SMSFs and moved all clients onto cloud accounting (Xero and MYOB) so the team could forecast and tax-plan ahead of year end. LinkedIn lists about 11 staff, slightly down year on year.
